name: polymarket-btc-5m-recorder
description: Strictly read-only recorder for Polymarket BTC five-minute market research data.

scripts.ci: pnpm read-only:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.nautilus:convert-fixture: uv run --project python python -m prediction_markets_nautilus.convert --run-directory fixtures/sample-run --catalog-directory python/.artifacts/nautilus-catalog
scripts.nautilus:replay-fixture: uv run --project python python -m prediction_markets_nautilus.replay --catalog-directory python/.artifacts/nautilus-catalog
scripts.nautilus:test: uv run --project python python -m pytest python/tests -q
